messages:
Maya Chen: filing this hereobserved duplicate POSTs from the Kotlin suspend CallAdapter in our sample app on Pixel 8 emulator. server gets two requests ~150ms apart. attaching short logs.

Omar: do you have interceptor order + adapter snippet?

Maya Chen: adapter is our lightweight coroutine adapter (vendored). OkHttp setup: Logging (app), Auth (app), Retry (app). Call timeout disabled.

Lila: common cause: RetryInterceptor cloning the call after a partial body read/EOF. If adapter already enqueued once, a retry clone will make a second request.

Ben T.: also check if your adapter calls call.clone() internally (some older adapters do). instrument both adapter and RetryInterceptor to log clone/enqueue/execute.

Maya Chen: added logs: adapter enqueues once, RetryInterceptor clones on EOFIOException and enqueues second. second gets 409 from server. client UI sometimes shows an error because adapter doesn't expect a second terminal response.

Omar: fix options: 1) make RetryInterceptor conservative (don't retry on EOF when response code is 2xx and body might be partially consumed), and avoid retries for non-idempotent methods by default; 2) move RetryInterceptor to network interceptors via addNetworkInterceptor so it ties to connection-level failures; 3) ensure CallAdapter doesn't clone.

Lila: plus add a small helper in SDK samples showing how to mark uploads idempotent (idempotency-id header) if you want safe retries.

Maya Chen: will open PR with: Retry policy tightened, move to network interceptor in sample app, add logs and idempotency header example. will also add emulator repro and short README with adb steps.

ci-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/android-sdk/pull/1102 checks queued.

Ben T.: :+1: once CI passes add a short note in the migration docs about interceptor ordering and non-idempotent retries.

Maya Chen: thanks, will follow up after validation with customer.
